capabilities: Format the active note with Autocorrect
Trigger formatting via hotkey, ribbon icon, or editor right-click menu
Batch format all notes in a folder
Batch format all Markdown files in the vault
disambiguation: Not a spellchecker; it formats Markdown content using the Autocorrect tool rather than correcting word choices.
extras: README lists every trigger path (hotkey, ribbon, context menu, folder/vault batch, command palette) and notes the hotkey can be changed in Obsidian's Hotkeys settings; it does not describe what Autocorrect changes in the text.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to apply Autocorrect formatting to notes or to format many notes at once.

relations.evidence: A plugin running on Obsidian ( that utilizes Autocorrect ( to format Markdown content.

summary: Formatter that runs the Autocorrect tool on note Markdown via hotkey, ribbon, context menu, or batch commands for folders and the whole vault.
